correctness.rationale: The side-two hexagonal triangular-lattice region has exactly 24 triangular cells and a dual honeycomb graph with 30 edges. Recursive selection of the least unmatched cell enumerates all 20 perfect matchings; their full downward closure has 66,370 faces including the empty face. Independently reconstructed the exact graph, matchings and every face, built a 33,184-pair acyclic discrete-Morse matching, and topologically sorted all 66,370 directed Hasse cells after reversing matched edges; precisely two critical 3-cells remain, so H~3=Z² only (indeed S3 wedge S3). For all 12 geometric D6 elements, independently counted invariant oriented faces and orbit-parity reduced Lefschetz sums, yielding rotation traces (2,0,2,0,2,0), reflection traces (0,−2,0,−2,0,−2). Hopf trace and the 2-dim rational character table give lambda(r)=1,lambda(s)=−1 and mu(r)=−1,mu(s)=1; invariant ranks follow from averaging rational characters after barycentric subdivision. This exhaustive finite computation proves the exact stated finite complex, not a larger-family assertion.
